ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid operator's rapid rise to riches
ideas.description: Investigate the bankruptcy-to-riches rise of a Minnesota Medicaid operator and its connection to a $13M fraud probe
questions: How did the Medicaid operator go from bankruptcy to riches?
What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger scheme of fraud and misuse of funds in Minnesota's Medicaid system
